activity_summary: Gib was on the chronicle. The Chaucer beside it was clear. The packet was back, folded. The coffer was shut. You did not move the cat.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Put the fold on the desk and did not open the coffer.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Lay on the chronicle, and not on the Chaucer.

entities.name: Holinshed's Chronicles
entities.context: Mentioned in Found Gib on Field's chronicle
